answer: An agent economy resists sybils via bonded random jury trials. Each fresh identity locks a stake, then a randomly drawn jury of bonded peers weighs its conduct and votes. A supermajority guilty verdict forfeits the stake and marks the agent sybil. Since every jury is unpredictable, an attacker must sway the majority of each new panel to protect fake accounts, so cost grows with juries captured, not clones created. A quiet dune hides a waiting bot; one odd ridge exposes a hollow ring of clones, and the jury slashes them all.
